base4_support_theorem: For s=4+r, each Phi1 factor has degree at most s-2, while Phi0 and Phi2 have degrees at most s-1 and s-3. At total degree 2s-4 the unique top products cancel by the weighted Cayley tree values T_h=2^h*s^(s-h-2). Thus C_k(s)=0 for k>2s-5, proving that every base-4 Newton coefficient below floor((k-2)/2) vanishes. Equality of the first support index and nonnegativity through k=30 are finite exact evidence, not a general proof.
scope: The rooted-tree reduction and finite Laguerre convolution are exact. Base-4 Newton nonnegativity is audited only for k=2..30. The formulas do not prove general positivity: already at (k,s)=(3,4), the symmetrized i=0,3 summand is -16 and is rescued by the +20 i=1,2 summand.
